# Preparing the data for PCA
```{r library, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(tibble)
library(ggrepel)  # for optional smart labels
library(svglite)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)


source('xrf_functions.R')
```

## Initial Parameters
```{r init, echo=FALSE}
# in this section: choose the resolution and top or all core for subsequent analysis

res <- 0.5 # resolution (mm) of the xrf dataset
res_micro <- 1000* res
half_res <- res/2
l_analysis <- 'bottom_' # either all core "AC_", "top_" or "bottom_"

if(l_analysis == 'AC_'){
  l_text <- 'all core'
} else if(l_analysis == 'top_') {
  l_text <- 'top 35cm'
} else{
  l_text <- 'bottom 35-123.1cm'
}

xrf_elem_ZnNi <- c('Fe','Mn','Ba','S','Ti','Al','Si','K', 'Ca', 'Rb', 'Zr', 'Sr', 'P', 'Ba','Ni','Zn','position..mm.')
xrf_elem <- c('Fe','Mn','Ba','S','Ti','Al','Si','K', 'Ca', 'Rb', 'Zr', 'Sr', 'P', 'Ba','position..mm.')
sel <- xrf_elem
features <- sel[!sel %in% c("position..mm.")]
print(paste('xrf resolution =', res_micro, 'µm'))
print(paste('analysis will be done on', l_text))
print('Feature selection:')
cat(features, sep = ', ')

```
## Load corresponding datasets
```{r load, echo=F}

path_combined_folder <- '/Users/maxshore/Documents/Unibe/MasterThesis/masterthesis/R/data/generated/combined/'
path_combined_file <- paste(path_combined_folder,'combined_',l_analysis, res_micro,'_inc_coh.csv', sep = '')

combined <- read.csv(path_combined_file)
df.raw <- load_raw_data()
```

## Prepare transformed data for PCA and clustering
```{r prepare data}

df.xrf <- clean_df(df.raw, sel = sel)

if(res_micro == 500){
  df.xrf$raw.200 <- NULL
  df.xrf <- tibble(df.xrf$raw.500)
} else {
  df.xrf$raw.500 <- NULL
  df.xrf <- tibble(df.xrf$raw.200)
} # selection of dataframe
if(l_analysis == 'top_'){
  df.xrf <- df.xrf %>%
    select_top_varves()
} # selection of top varves
if(l_analysis == 'bottom_'){
  df.xrf <- df.xrf %>%
    select_bottom()
}
df.cs <- closed_sum(df.xrf) 
df.clr <- clr_transform(df.xrf)
```

## Perform PCA and k-means clustering
``` {r pca and cluster dataframes}
pca.df <- perform_pca2(df.clr)
X <- scale(df.clr %>% select(-position..mm.))
# Choose optimal number of clusters
f_clust <- fviz_nbclust(X, kmeans, method = "silhouette") +
  theme_minimal()
print(f_clust)
n_clust <- f_clust$data
optimal_clust <- as.numeric(n_clust$clusters[which.max(n_clust$y)])


print(paste('Optimal number of clusters is', optimal_clust))

km <- kmeans(X, centers = optimal_clust, nstart = 25)

scores <- as_tibble(pca.df$x)
loadings <- as_tibble(pca.df$rotation, rownames = "variable")

# Rescale loadings to match sample space
loadings_scaled <- loadings %>%
  mutate(
    PC1 = PC1 * pca.df$sdev[1],
    PC2 = PC2 * pca.df$sdev[2],
    PC3 = PC3 * pca.df$sdev[3]
  )

#  Add metadata for faceting
scores <- scores %>%
  mutate(depth = pca.df$position..mm.) %>%
  mutate(kcluster = as.factor(km$cluster))

var_expl <- round(100 * pca.df$sdev^2 / sum(pca.df$sdev^2), 1)
cum_var <- cumsum(var_expl)
pc_names = pca.df$rotation %>% colnames()
var_pca <- tibble(
  pc = pc_names,
  var_expl = var_expl,
  cum_var = cum_var
)
var_pca <- var_pca %>%
  mutate(pc = factor(pc, levels = pc))

p_var_expl <- ggplot(var_pca, aes(x = pc)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = var_expl), stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cum_var, group = 1), color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cum_var), color = "red", size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Principal Component",
    y = "Explained Variance (%)",
    title = "Explained and Cumulative Variance by PC"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_var_expl)
fviz_contrib(pca.df, choice='var', axes = c(1))
fviz_contrib(pca.df, choice = 'var', axes = c(2))
fviz_contrib(pca.df, choice='var', axes = c(3))


```


## Biplots of PC1, PC2 and PC3

### PC1 vs PC2 - Depth facteting

```{r biplot depth 1_2, echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=F, include=T, fig.width=10}

pcs <- '1_2'
p.depth12 <- ggplot() +
  # Sample points colored by depth
  geom_point(data = scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = depth),
             shape = 16, size = 1.5) +
  
  # Loadings arrows
  geom_segment(data = loadings_scaled,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * 8, yend = PC2 * 8),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Loadings labels
  geom_text_repel(data = loadings_scaled,
                  aes(x = PC1 * 8.5, y = PC2 * 8.5, label = variable),
                  size = 6, color = "black") +
  
  # Center lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
  
  # Axes and theme
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", var_expl[1], "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", var_expl[2], "%)")) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_colour_gradient(
    low = "#c6dbef",
    high = "#08306b",
    name = "Depth (mm)",
    guide = guide_colorbar(reverse = TRUE)  # must go here
  ) +  # blue scale
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle(paste("PCA Biplot Colored by Depth -", res_micro, 'µm ', l_text, 
                sep = ''))
print(p.depth12)
output_dir <- 'plots/PCA_plots_'
output_subdir <- paste(l_analysis,res_micro, sep = '')
filename.svg <- paste(output_dir,output_subdir, '/depth', pcs,'.svg', sep = '')
filename.png <- paste(output_dir,output_subdir, '/depth', pcs,'.png', sep = '')
invisible(save_svg_plot(p.depth12, filename.svg, width = 15, height = 10))
ggsave(filename.png, plot = p.depth12, width = 80, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 600)


```

### PC1 vs PC2 - K-means cluster faceting

```{r biplot cluster 1_2,  echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=F, include=T, fig.width=10}
if(optimal_clust == 2){
  col_pal <- c("#8856a7","#b3cde3")
} else if (optimal_clust == 3) {
  col_pal <- c('#8856a7','#9ebcda','#e0ecf4')
} else {
  col_pal <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(optimal_clust, 'Purples')
}
pcs <- '1_2'
p.clust12 <- ggplot() +
  # Sample points colored by depth
  geom_point(data = scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = kcluster),
             shape = 16, size = 1.5) +
  
  # ellipse over points
  stat_ellipse(data = scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = kcluster), 
               type = "norm", level = 0.68) +
  # Loadings arrows
  geom_segment(data = loadings_scaled,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1 * 8, yend = PC2 * 8),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Loadings labels
  geom_text_repel(data = loadings_scaled,
                  aes(x = PC1 * 8.5, y = PC2 * 8.5, label = variable),
                  size = 5, color = "black") +
  
  # Center lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
  
  # Axes and theme
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", var_expl[1], "%)")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", var_expl[2], "%)")) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_pal) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle(paste("PCA Biplot Colored by K-means Cluster - ", res_micro, 'µm ', l_text, 
                sep=''))

print(p.clust12)

output_dir <- 'plots/PCA_plots_'
output_subdir <- paste(l_analysis,res_micro, sep = '')
filename.svg <- paste(output_dir,output_subdir, '/kmeans', pcs,'.svg', sep = '')
filename.png <- paste(output_dir,output_subdir, '/kmeans', pcs,'.png', sep = '')
invisible(save_svg_plot(p.clust12, filename.svg, width = 15, height = 10))
ggsave(filename.png, plot = p.clust12, width = 80, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 600)
```

## Downcore variations of Principal Components

### PC1 

```{r downcore PC1, echo=F, message=FALSE, warning=F, include=T, fig.height=12}

# select PC to plot
pc_num <- 'PC1'
# plot downcore
p.dc1 <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = depth, y = .data[[pc_num]])) +
  # PCA line
  geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  
  # Positive ribbon (blue)
  geom_ribbon(aes(
    ymin = 0,
    ymax = ifelse(.data[[pc_num]] > 0, .data[[pc_num]], 0)
  ),
  fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.6) +  # Colorblind-safe blue
  
  # Negative ribbon (red)
  geom_ribbon(aes(
    ymin = ifelse(.data[[pc_num]] < 0, .data[[pc_num]], 0),
    ymax = 0
  ),
  fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.6) +  # Colorblind-safe red
  
  # Zero line
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.2) +
  
  # Labels and scales
  labs(
    title = paste0(pc_num, " Downcore Profile \n", res_micro, 'µm ', l_text),
    x = "Depth (mm)",
    y = paste0(pc_num, " Score")
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  
  # Theme and layout
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio = 3
  )


print(p.dc1)

output_dir <- 'plots/PCdowncore'
plot_name <- paste(res_micro, pc_num, sep = '_')
plot_name.svg <- paste(plot_name,'.svg', sep = '')
plot_name.png <- paste(plot_name,'.png', sep = '')
filename.svg <- file.path(output_dir, plot_name.svg)
filename.png <- file.path(output_dir, plot_name.png)

invisible(save_svg_plot(p.dc1, filename.svg, width = 3, height = 8))
ggsave(filename.png, plot = p.dc1, width = 80, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 600)

```
